title: Netflix TV v1.2.5
changelog: Fixed universal movie playback across all titles including The Notebook and The Good Lawyer
Enabled dynamic multi-provider direct HLS streaming across FrameX provider pool (giant, bowler, executioner, grand_warden)
Eliminated 'We Couldn't Find This Content' stall by preventing iframe onLoad from prematurely cancelling watchdog
Enhanced automated fallback watchdog timer to advance across all 5 streaming servers smoothly
Removed forced provider restrictions and obsolete domain configurations
Time played and time remaining side-by-side on scrubber bar with full D-Pad seeking support
